title: Interplay between geometry, electron density, and polarizability of the controversial drug atoxyl in crystal and biological environments
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,46749-46760
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05936D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yaser Balmohammadi, Eduardo Metry, Lorraine A. Malaspina, Georgia Cametti, Yuiga Nakamura, Simon Grabowsky
Arsenic is infamous for its toxicity; and yet, As compounds such as atoxyl have been used and misused for therapeutic purposes. Here, we use quantum crystallography to understand atoxyl's behavior in different environments.
